column1: # *** WHAT TO DO WITH IT, AND WHAT NOT TO. ***
# NOT to import it. This is one tree's working file and it is unsourced here.
# *** What makes it testable is that almost every line names a PARISH AND A DATE: *** Westleigh,
# Coldridge, Braunton, Shirwell, Holsworthy, Bideford and Northam in north Devon; Haddington in East
# Lothian; St Martin-in-the-Fields and St Bartholomew's in London. *** North Devon parish registers
# are filmed and this archive knows how to read a filmed register by number. ***
# *** The first three to test, because they carry the most weight and the most specific detail: ***
#   1. The marriage of 26 January 1870 at St Mark's, Bideford - Mary Ann Hellen Brayley to William Taylor.
#   2. The marriage of 9 July 1839 at St Martin-in-the-Fields - John Brailey to Georgina Temple.
#   3. The death of 4 May 1851 at the Devon County Asylum - John Brailey, aged 36.
